title: is_encoding_problem set true on truncation mid-codepoint
description: mime-tree/src/decode.rs: when max_bytes truncates mid-multibyte-char, encoding_rs emits replacement char and sets had_errors=true, which sets is_encoding_problem=true. Doc says 'unmappable characters' but this fires on truncation too. Callers cannot distinguish real corruption from truncation artifact. Fix: add doc comment clarifying is_encoding_problem may be set when max_bytes truncates mid-codepoint.
